evening.caption:
Sky touched one tiny seed, and a whole garden woke up 🌱

Sky is the gentle Yin spirit, and when she met the first green shoot she became Yin Wood: the flower, the vine, the soft grass that finds its way through any crack. Yi Wood doesn't push like a big tree. It bends, it climbs, it wraps around what is in its way and keeps growing toward the light. In people, it is the kind, flexible, quietly determined side that makes friends easily, helps others bloom and turns a bare patch into something beautiful. Small, patient care can change a whole landscape.

Who is the gardener in your life, the one who helps everyone around them grow? Tag them below 👇
